direct_candidate.command: codex exec --ephemeral --json --sandbox read-only --disable shell_tool --disable plugins --disable apps --disable hooks --cd <PACKET_DIR> --model <SELECTED_MODEL> --output-schema <RESULT_SCHEMA> <PROMPT>
direct_candidate.provider_handling: Leaves the configured provider unchanged and passes the selected model as input; provider identity/readback is not qualified.

provider_free_boundary_probe.meaning: The named read-only profile and no-network outer sandbox parsed and ran a provider-free command.
provider_free_boundary_probe.not_a_model_invocation: Do not nest a model invocation under this no-network boundary: it would likely block the provider transport.

help_only_parse.command: codex exec --disable shell_tool --disable plugins --disable apps --disable hooks --help
help_only_parse.meaning: The listed per-run feature disables parsed; their live runtime effects were not tested.

unverified_or_unsupported_for_native_qua: Actual JSONL event fields for structured result, usage, completion, or truncation receipts.
Configured-provider identity preservation and selected-model readback.
Fresh-context isolation, ephemeral cleanup, cancellation, child-process ownership, and no-replay recovery.
Runtime effect of disabling shell_tool, plugins, apps, and hooks, including native MCP tools or user-configured extensions.
Arbitrary source-execution prevention; help text alone does not qualify this boundary.
A selected total model-session ceiling, reservation, baseline parity, or live model-session receipts.
non_actions: No account configuration inspection or mutation
next_gate: Keep review automation at provider-free packet/record level until an operator selects a ceiling and native lifecycle/receipt controls pass bounded qualification.
legacy_standalone_sandbox_probe: The earlier -c sandbox_mode probe refused; the named :read-only permission profile was required by that surface.
